home.title: ZooNotify — Zoonotic Disease Surveillance Data from the BfR
home.description: Web-based query tool for surveillance data collected under Directive 99/2003/EC (Zoonoses Directive): pathogen findings along the food chain, published by the BfR.

prevalence.description: Prevalence of zoonotic pathogens along the German food chain — explore the data interactively by pathogen, matrix and sampling stage.

antibioticResistance.datasetName: Antimicrobial resistance in zoonotic and commensal bacteria (Germany)

microbialCounts.description: Microbial counts along the German food chain, collected as part of the national zoonoses monitoring programme.
microbialCounts.datasetName: Microbial counts along the food chain (Germany)

antimicrobial.title: Antimicrobial Use

evaluations.title: Evaluations
evaluations.description: Charts and time series covering zoonotic pathogens, antimicrobial resistance and microbial counts from the German zoonoses monitoring programme.
